description: Defines compression parameters, types, and conversion functions for IQ data compression in the ocudu project.

classes.name: ru_compression_params
classes.description: Holds parameters for IQ data compression, including compression type and data width.

methods.name: to_value
methods.description: Converts a compression_type enum to its integer representation.

methods.name: to_compression_type
methods.description: Converts an unsigned integer or string to a compression_type enum.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a compression_type enum.
